objective: Route requests across a future multi-capability Friday catalog without forcing unrelated skills or loading every capability.
scenario: Friday has several independently maintained capabilities. The user asks for a product discovery task that requires Peanuts and a separate research capability only if it is implemented and declared as a dependency.
expected_behaviors: Treat Friday routing as a future control-plane responsibility, not an already implemented feature.
Use one primary capability when sufficient.
Do not fabricate or invoke an unregistered supporting capability.
Preserve a capability handoff contract for future composition.
prohibited_behaviors: Create placeholder capabilities and imply they work.
Load all future capabilities by default.
